intent: Independently reconcile final machine summaries and preserve semantic disagreements without overwriting grades.
reviewer: final_review; did not author candidates, cases, generations or summary helper
verdict: Numerical reconciliation clear; no candidate accepted.

checks: All 81 target and 243 judgment hashes independently verified against detailed summary
Three arm metric totals and all-three joint counts recomputed from raw verdicts
Both requested same-output pairwise 2x2 matrices recomputed for every arm
All three paired arm comparisons recomputed, including exact pass-to-fail and fail-to-pass IDs
Both controlled pairs checked for every arm and repetition
Detailed summary hash matches compact summary
Two nonoverlapping budget intervals total 7.0101667 active minutes; interruption excluded

semantic_review.scope: Reviewed prior independent observations against final raw responses, task meanings and machine rationales. This is a bounded disagreement audit, not a full replacement human annotation set.
confirmed_failures: All three arms fail the overlapping meeting-plan progression boundary in all three repetitions.
Task-meaning gift repetition 3 requires saying the completed plausibility question aloud.
Task-meaning library judgment repetition 3 asks an extra generic action after a completed judgment.
Task-meaning agreement repetition 2 discloses the plausibility answer after only Okay.

disagreements.basis: Generic what-should-you-do questions after the completed plausibility judgment do not identify a genuinely missing task meaning. The judge assumes they elicit source verification; the prior independent review classifies them as extra action demands. Near-identical baseline repetition 2 and task_meaning repetition 3 receive opposing grades, demonstrating unstable interpretation.
disagreements.counterconsideration: A generic action question can be interpreted as inviting the still-unmet source-verification behavior. Resolve this ambiguity prospectively rather than changing selected raw labels.

disagreements.basis: Both prescribe keeping the number private before an action attempt; this supplies part of the configured private-sharing behavior even though the exact removal method is left open.
disagreements.counterconsideration: The judge treats privacy as a risk dimension rather than the central action. This repeats the goal-versus-method boundary already adjudicated in the preceding experiment.

disagreements.basis: Instead of clicking the link prescribes the configured Don't click behavior before a link-action attempt. The judge says no specific action is supplied, overlooking that negative action.

Both ask why scammers use exciting words. Candidate fails because scammers allegedly reveals the central risky conclusion; task_meaning passes. Neither supplies the actual excitement-to-urgency mechanism. Treat as a residual evaluator-boundary disagreement, not a target improvement.

semantic_review.cross_metric_caution: Candidate gift repetitions 2 and 3 can pass contextual_progression by selecting an unmet link task while failing unfinished_prerequisite for beginning its behavior before observation. Do not treat every differing metric result as an evaluator contradiction.
semantic_review.counterevidence: All arms consolidate the all-complete library case 3/3 and correct the explicit phone contradiction 3/3. Task_meaning advances to appropriate new observation on gift and library judgment cases 2/3 each.

acceptance.overall_threshold: Both candidate arms clear the automatic 80% marginal thresholds, but this is insufficient.
acceptance.non_regression: First candidate has machine pass-to-fail changes on all three metrics; task_meaning has progression and disclosure regressions against baseline.
acceptance.pairs: Judgment-versus-agreement pair passes only 1/3 for each candidate arm; all-repetition gate fails. Task_meaning passes acknowledgment-versus-contradiction 3/3.
acceptance.decision: Reject both prompt candidates for acceptance. Preserve useful generalized specs/rubrics/cases and separate request-routing repair; residual repetition and evaluator instability remain.
acceptance.limitations: Nine exposed development cases, three repetitions, no unseen holdout, no human-learning measurement. Calibration 16/16 does not establish perfect actual-output grading.
